The three holes sit on the -X axis (180°) and at upper-right and lower-right positions consistent with 360/3 = 120° spacing (60° and 300°). So count 3, radius 105 and start_angle 180 match the drawn layout. Opening face: the hidden counterbore recesses in the side view open from the face opposite datum A. The isometric's visible face shows only small hole openings and no larger recesses, and that face appears to be the +Z face: its edge thickness shows on the right and top, and the hole layout matches the front view. So the counterbores open from the bottom (Z=0). The step remains valid for 25,0. The feature cites exact source IDs.
